money.notes: Estimated cost including GST. Tender fee: Not Applicable. EMD by DD/FDR from any commercial bank in favour of the Director, Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata, to reach the Tender Inviting Authority by 27.03.2026 0300 PM; bidders with valid NSIC/MSME registration in the subject work exempted.

eligibility: Experience in similar works i.e. Installation/AMC/CAMC for elevator/escalator in Central Govt./State Govt./PSU/Autonomous bodies/reputed private establishment
Original uploaded documents (bid acceptance, notarized affidavit) to be submitted at signing of contract agreement
notes: Document contains only Section 1 NIT (printed pages 3-5); no BOQ or technical scope. Dates are internally inconsistent: bid submission period printed as '16.03.2026- 26.04.2026 up to 1500 Hrs' and technical bid opening as '27.03.04.2026 at 1600 Hrs', while EMD is due 27.03.2026; the listing gives end 2026-03-26 and opening 2026-03-27, so the printed 26.04.2026 is probably a typo for 26.03.2026. Submission end and opening left null because of the conflict. Filename is NIQLift but document is headed Notice Inviting e-Tender.
